facts.quote: Another tactic that’s worked well for Fly by Jing as part of its community-building strategy, according to Patricio-Archer, is partnering with other brands.

By the time Fly By Jing pursued retail partnerships with Whole Foods, Target, and eventually broader grocery distribution, the brand had something most emerging CPG products don’t: pre-existing demand signals.
For this week’s Modern Retail Talk, founder and CEO Jing Gao spoke about her trials and tribulations during the coronavirus.

Hi Fly By Jing team,

We’re reaching out to propose a collaborative Instagram post that highlights your community-building strategy, inspired by Patricio-Archer's insights on partnering with other brands [F1]. This post would celebrate the spirit of Fly By Jing and their impact on the industry, building on the ideas shared during a conversation about community engagement [F2]. The post would feature a visually appealing slide that showcases your team's creative interpretation of that conversation, which would be a shared Instagram experience for your audience [F3]. It would be a great way to further amplify your message and engage with your community, and it would be a fun way to share your creativity with your audience.

The BrandPilot team
